cs.t: Perixx Periboard 507ii (that's the European version):  https://www.amazon.de/dp/B07DTKF8SK  It is a little noisy, and I have problems configuring the buttons as a mouse while keeping the trackpad as a trackpad, but the finger travelling is good, and the layout feels very much like the old, renowned MS Natural keyboards.
cs.th: Ask HN: What's your keyboard and what you love and hate about it?

cs.t: Evoluent Vertical Mouse. Mouse lasted for about 4 years (the middle scroll wheel stopped working), and replacement mouse purchased is still going strong.  https://evoluent.com/products/vm4rw/  My wrist would ached so much when working at a computer until I started using it. Then got a PERIBOARD-409 keyboard ( https://www.amazon.com/Perixx-PERIBOARD-409U-Mini-Keyboard-1... ) that would allow me to keep the mouse closer to the keyboard.
